prompt: What is our loss ratio for Residential vs Commercial?
sql:
SELECT 
  p.productcode AS product_line,
  SUM(pp.totalpremium) AS total_written_premium,
  COALESCE(SUM(f.netincurred), 0) AS total_incurred_loss,
  ROUND(CAST(COALESCE(SUM(f.netincurred), 0) AS NUMERIC) / NULLIF(SUM(pp.totalpremium), 0) * 100, 2) AS loss_ratio_pct
FROM pc_policy p
JOIN pc_policyperiod pp ON p.id = pp.policy_id
LEFT JOIN cc_claim c ON p.id = c.policy_id
LEFT JOIN cc_financials f ON c.id = f.claim_id
GROUP BY p.productcode LIMIT 200

prompt: Show top 10 open Commercial claims with reserves over $50,000
sql:
SELECT 
  c.claimnumber,
  p.productcode,
  c.losscause,
  c.lossdate,
  f.totalreserves,
  f.totalpaid,
  f.netincurred
FROM cc_claim c
JOIN pc_policy p ON c.policy_id = p.id
JOIN cc_financials f ON c.id = f.claim_id
WHERE c.status = 'Open' AND f.totalreserves >= 50000
ORDER BY f.totalreserves DESC
LIMIT 10

prompt: give me policy that are expired last month
sql:
SELECT 
  pp.policynumber,
  pp.policytype_ext AS policy_type,
  a.accountname,
  a.accountnumber,
  pp.policypereffdate AS effective_date,
  pp.policyperexpirdate AS expiration_date,
  pp.cancelstatus AS status
FROM bc_policyperiod pp
JOIN bc_account a ON pp.accountid = a.id
WHERE pp.cancelstatus = 'Expired' OR pp.policyperexpirdate <= CURRENT_DATE
ORDER BY pp.policyperexpirdate DESC
LIMIT 10

prompt: show lockbox payments received from remittance batch process with policy number
sql:
SELECT 
  l.externalpaymentreference,
  l.controlcode,
  l.sequencenumber,
  l.boacoupontype,
  l.amountpaid,
  l.amountdue,
  pp.policynumber,
  a.accountname,
  a.accountnumber,
  b.refnumber AS payment_ref,
  l.refnumberinternal,
  l.createtime AS batch_processed_time
FROM bcx_lockboxlineitem_ext l
LEFT JOIN bc_basemoneyreceived b ON (l.moneyreceived = b.id OR l.moneyreceived_id = b.id)
LEFT JOIN bc_policyperiod pp ON (b.policyperiodid = pp.id OR b.policyperiod_id = pp.id)
LEFT JOIN bc_account a ON (b.accountid = a.id OR b.account_id = a.id)
ORDER BY l.createtime DESC
LIMIT 10
